title: ग्रामर: big, bigger, biggest और Yes, I do
Grammar: big, bigger, biggest aur Yes, I do
Grammar in Use: big, bigger, biggest and Yes, I do

card: big (बड़ा) → bigger (ज़्यादा बड़ा) → biggest (सबसे बड़ा)। ज़्यादातर शब्दों में -er और -est लगाते हैं: tall, taller, tallest।
big (bada) → bigger (zyaada bada) → biggest (sabse bada). Zyaadatar shabdon mein -er aur -est lagaate hain: tall, taller, tallest.
big → bigger → biggest. Most words just add -er and -est: tall, taller, tallest.
